contract: per output char: isize change; 0 = replaces one input char; +1 = inserted (consumes no input); -N = replaces one input char and removes the N following input chars; consumption is positional in output order

vectors.label: comb-compose-A-ring

vectors.label: comb-reorder-acute-dot
